title: opengotchi
tagline: opengotchi is a cute pet for your agent that runs gotchios.
description:
Most AI agents are stuck in chat. OpenGotchi gives yours a device to run. 

Opengotchi (https://x.com/opengotchi) is the world's first agentic AI Tamagotchi - an open-source ESP32 running GotchiOS, an OS so lean any agent can understand the whole device in one read and ship working apps in one prompt.
No firmware flashing. Just a hash key + skill.md.


Some micro-apps I vibecoded with my quant:
🔹 Press a button 5 times → orders Diet Coke from Instamart
🔹 Rings on your desk twice a day to take vitamins
🔹 ADHD games to keep me busy while Claude thinks


Feed it to OpenClaw, Claude Code, Hermes -  whatever you run. Your Jarvis becomes Vision.
Open source. Actually ships .
how_its_made:
gotchios firmware built using c and micropython 
website built using nextjs
services powered by mqtt servers and go backend
microapps built using micropython
we used dynamic wallets to give server side wallets to each device with the unique identifier
ens to give human readable names to each device wallet and also for x402 payments
blink for depositing usdc into those wallets for x402 payments
auto_summary: An ESP32 pet-agent platform with a Go/MQTT-backed server that assigns wallets, ENS identities, and payment flows to devices.
